lines.text: After leaving Bethany, hungry Jesus finds only leaves on a fig tree and says no one will ever eat its fruit again.
In the temple courts in Jerusalem, Jesus overturns the tables of the tax collectors and the seats of those selling doves.
Jesus says God's house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations, but they have made it a den of robbers.
The next morning, Thomas sees the fig tree withered from its roots and says it has withered.
Jesus tells them to have faith in God, believe they have received what they ask in prayer, and forgive others.
